audit.source: saved dated public evidence and previous public research directions

opportunities.title: Reader Gallery Print
opportunities.audience: Book lovers seeking wall decor for libraries or reading nooks
opportunities.concept: A gallery print composition featuring a stylized illustration of a bookshelf filled with generic spines, framed by a bold border suitable for framing. The visual focuses on the texture of books and warm lighting rather than specific titles.

opportunities.title: Personalized Pet Watercolor Ornament
opportunities.audience: Pet owners looking for holiday gifts or keepsakes featuring their specific pet's name and portrait
opportunities.concept: A watercolor-style illustration of a cat or dog with a dedicated text area at the bottom for the buyer to input their pet's name. The design must adhere to small-area printing guidelines.

opportunities.title: Nonpersonalized Bookish Cat DTG Crewneck
opportunities.audience: Readers and cat lovers looking for casual apparel with a literary theme
opportunities.concept: A crewneck sweatshirt featuring a DTG print of a cat holding a generic book or sitting on a stack of books. The design avoids specific titles to remain non-copyrighted.

report.summary: Three product hypotheses from saved evidence. Their ranking is a model suggestion, not measured demand or profitability.

opportunities.title: Reader Gallery Print
opportunities.audience: Book lovers seeking wall decor for libraries or reading nooks
opportunities.concept: A gallery print composition featuring a stylized illustration of a bookshelf filled with generic spines, framed by a bold border suitable for framing. The visual focuses on the texture of books and warm lighting rather than specific titles.
opportunities.evidence:
Etsy · Spring and Summer 2026 trend report — Data as of 2026-02-10; recent three months versus prior year; published 2026-03-17. Gallery prints +80% and wall-art decor +110% are broad category search signals. They do not establish current demand for reader-specific illustrations or profitable prints. No exact product search volume, item sales or conversion is supplied.

Printify · Custom posters — Saved general product-family information; no selected supplier quote. Print-on-demand framed and unframed posters are feasible product families. This page establishes supply only, not demand, shipping cost, variant margin or a reason to prefer wall art over other products.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'bookshelf gallery print' in Marketplace Insights for searches, listings and displayed period. Obtain a dated account quote for the exact poster, provider, paper, size and framing variant with shipping to the chosen destination. Subtract actual platform/payment/listing fees, applicable ads, returns and labor. Starting prices are not selected-variant quotes.

opportunities.title: Personalized Pet Watercolor Ornament
opportunities.audience: Pet owners looking for holiday gifts or keepsakes featuring their specific pet's name and portrait
opportunities.concept: A watercolor-style illustration of a cat or dog with a dedicated text area at the bottom for the buyer to input their pet's name. The design must adhere to small-area printing guidelines.
opportunities.evidence:
Etsy · Personalized pet watercolor ornament, ModPawsUS — Retrieved public page snapshot; visible review examples from 2025 and January 2026. Six item reviews, 4.7 item rating. Photo/name customization requires per-order artwork and proofs. Shop sales are not item sales. No current item sales volume or profit is available; snapshot may be cached/localized.

Printify · Ceramic ornament design guidelines — Guidance retrieved 2026-10-30; selected product template still required. Small print area needs bold text/lines and safe-area placement. Tiny details and pale gradients risk poor reproduction. Guidance is production feasibility evidence, not buyer demand or an exact template.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'personalized pet watercolor ornament' in Marketplace Insights for searches, listings and displayed period. Obtain a dated account quote for the exact ceramic ornament, provider and template; include per-order artwork/proof labor with shipping to the chosen destination. Subtract actual platform/payment/listing fees, applicable ads, returns and labor. Starting prices are not selected-variant quotes.

opportunities.title: Nonpersonalized Bookish Cat DTG Crewneck
opportunities.audience: Readers and cat lovers looking for casual apparel with a literary theme
opportunities.concept: A crewneck sweatshirt featuring a DTG print of a cat holding a generic book or sitting on a stack of books. The design avoids specific titles to remain non-copyrighted.
opportunities.evidence:
Etsy · Book-cat embroidered sweatshirt, FurFamilyStudio — Retrieved public page snapshot; one review dated 2026-01-17. One item review, 5.0 rating. Gift purchase evidence only; a tiny sample. Embroidery differs from a DTG printed product. Shop totals and offer prices cannot establish this item's sales, conversion or profitability. Snapshot may be cached/localized.

Printify · Gildan 18000 crewneck catalog — Public starting-price snapshot; actual selected account quote unavailable. US Printify Choice DTG catalog starts at USD 17.87 plus shipping from USD 7.39. These are starting estimates, not a selected variant/provider quote or verified contribution. Account prices, destination, print area and availability must be checked before preparing a listing.
opportunities.nextStep: Check 'bookish cat sweatshirt' in Marketplace Insights for searches, listings and displayed period. Obtain a dated account quote for Gildan 18000, exact provider, DTG front, US size M with shipping to the chosen destination. Subtract actual platform/payment/listing fees, applicable ads, returns and labor. Starting prices are not selected-variant quotes.

limitations: Analysis of saved evidence only; no live Etsy or competitor data was collected.
Concepts and suggested keywords are model proposals, not verified market facts.
Exact-product demand, supplier variant quotes, shipping, fees and margins remain unverified.
